protocol.predeclared_targets: third Full, then first saved Fast following that Full
protocol.predeclared_single_modules: B4/task1/init19 third Full in each suite; all 17 FFN and Attention individually, no outcome-based replacement
protocol.score: first three Fulls: one raw D10 VJP each, and an error D10 VJP only on third Full; no Fast VJP
protocol.counterfactual_reference: complete current-observation native VLM plus D2, same seed
protocol.normalization: raw action coordinates are checkpoint-normalized; per-dimension RMSE has no outcome-dependent rescaling
protocol.physical_units: OSC clipped/scaled delta translation in meters and axis-angle command vector in radians; not rollout end-effector displacement
protocol.history: own episode, actual Full env steps; read previous banks before appending current Full
protocol.replay_boundary: error direction is native BF16-state residual difference; VJP is approximate PyTorch Full-D10 replay
